0:aside#voice-panel.settings.popover: .popover { position: absolute; top: 48px; right: 16px; width: 320px; background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; padding: 14px; box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.18); z-index: 10; }
3:div.voice__turns: .voice__turns { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; max-height: 40vh; overflow-y: auto; }
4:div.voice__turn.voice__turn--user: .voice__turn--user { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--working) 14%, transparent); align-self: flex-end; }
6:div.voice__pending: .voice__pending { padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 8px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--awaiting) 14%, transparent); font-size: 13px; }
9:button.card__btn: .settings button { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; padding: 5px 10px; color: var(--text); cursor: pointer; }
.card__btn { background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; color: var(--text); cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; white-space: nowrap; }
11:div.voice__turns: .voice__turns { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; max-height: 40vh; overflow-y: auto; }
